seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: January, November and December. Driest: June, July and August. Hottest: August (25.0°C average). Coolest: January (12.5°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.

laws.rule: The laws of Gibraltar are similar to UK laws for alcohol, drugs and anti-social behaviour.
laws.heading: Alcohol and drug laws

laws.rule: Same-sex sexual activity is legal. There is an active LGBT+ community, but due to the small size of Gibraltar, there are few places which are exclusively LGBT+ orientated. Read more advice for LGBT+ travellers .
laws.heading: LGBT+ travellers

laws.rule: Pounds sterling is the currency in Gibraltar. Bank of England-issued notes and UK coins are accepted and are mixed with locally-issued notes and coins of the same value in pounds and pence. Some businesses accept euros, but check the exchange rate offered. Notes issued in Scotland or Northern Ireland are not usually accepted in Gibraltar. Gibraltar-issued notes and coins are not usually accepted in the UK.
laws.heading: Money
